observations.why: Contraction and first-person plural announce a decision in conversational register, a departure from the memo's structured baseline.
Bare benefit claims stated as flat instrumental fragments with no hedging or elaboration — a strong instantiation of matter-of-fact delivery.
Bolded field labels, arrow notation, and native database vocabulary mark a structured technical-formal register, a clear departure from the spoken-style baseline of the first two segments.

mints.name: StructuredTechnicalMemoVoice
mints.title: bolded field labels and native jargon in a structured summary block
mints.frame: Does the expression shift into a formatted, field-labeled technical register that re-presents prior discussion as a structured artifact?
